name: Rechargeable Double-Ended Mist Fan
subtitle: 5000mAh Portable Fan With Spray
description: This USB rechargeable mist fan combines two fan heads with fine spray mist for personal cooling at a desk, bedside, or during travel. Its 5000mAh battery, three speed levels, adjustable vertical tilt, and remote control support flexible everyday use.
story: Built for personal spaces where a full-size fan is impractical, this compact unit combines directional airflow with a refillable 100ml water tank for optional misting. Choose among three speeds, angle the fan vertically, or use the remote from up to 5 metres. The rechargeable 5000mAh battery runs up to 8 hours on low, with shorter runtimes at higher speeds. USB Type-C charging and a listed noise level of ≤45 dB make it suited to desks, bedside use, study areas, and travel.
highlights: Dual fan heads for wider airflow
shipping: Estimated delivery in around 7 days. Delivery may arrive earlier or take longer depending on your destination and carrier.
